alt: 園丁用一壺水澆灌同一花圃裡的蔬菜和花朵。
scene_prompt: In a sunny home vegetable garden, one person waters a raised bed with one watering can; the same stream nourishes both leafy vegetables and blooming flowers growing side by side in the same bed. A small harvest basket and a vase of freshly cut matching flowers visibly show the two useful results: food and beauty from one gardening task. One watering action, cheerful clear composition.
